items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Flags Cost Strain While Ed Bastian Details Seat Reforms
items.summary: Delta Air Lines (NYSE:DAL) CEO Ed Bastian highlighted rising costs against strong travel demand in fresh remarks this week. Bastian pointed to higher jet fuel, airport fees, and labor expenses as key pressures on profitability despite fuller planes. He also outlined moves to refine seat allocation policies, including how window seats are assigned to passengers. items.title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.
